subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the text within 70-80 words.
guide_solution: Summary The passage mainly deals with the communication system. Students, teachers, corporate world and people of all walks of life in the world wish to communicate with each other for multiple reasons. Communication through postal mail has become redundant and phone calls are not always viable for many users. To ease communication for all, e- mail is the best possible solution in the current world. We cannot do a moment without communication. So for communication with each other, email is a must.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Khulna Public College. Sl. No. 70; Page No. 117
